answer_verbatim:

- Yelp - good for detailed patient feedback
- Healthgrades.com - medical professional ratings
- Your insurance provider's website - see in-network options
- Ask for referrals from friends, family, or your primary care doctor

**What to look for:**
- Good reviews (especially for cleanings/checkups)
